notes.subject: ואחלצה
notes.rationale: KJV 'delivered him that without cause is mine enemy' vs JPS 'spoiled mine adversary unto emptiness' — pulim isi o rausim samting long em.

notes.subject: שולמי
notes.rationale: 'ol man i stap long pis wantaim mi' (KJV, BSB) o 'ol man i tokim mi raut' (JPS) — huz duet i stap long han bilong husat.

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: ves bilong David long ples bilong Kot — em i kot tok long nem bilong em yet; mi no bin pawa'im raut long ol pren bilong mi.

translation: Sapos mi pawa'im raut long ol man i stap long pis wantaim mi, na sapos mi pulim ⟨em⟩ isi long ol birua bilong mi long nating —

tokens.gloss: ol man i stap long pis wantaim mi
